Missing Note.name: Missing Note
Missing Note.description: The user sends a fan of slow discs around a blind corner in a tiled corridor and listens for the banks off the far wall. Each disc rings at a lower pitch on each bounce. Over two turns the user tests neighboring paths and marks the edges of a hidden obstruction within twenty meters by the notes it cuts short. The discs tap softly enough to leave a person unhurt. An open doorway and a padded surface both silence a disc, so the user needs to know the layout. Strain: severe.
